CloudflareMailAccountId.description: Cloudflare account ID that owns the Email Service sending domain.

CloudflareMailApiToken.description: Cloudflare API token with the "Email Sending: Edit" permission. Keep this out of version control, e.g. read it from an environment variable.

CloudflareMailApiBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the Cloudflare API. Only change this for testing.

CloudflareMailTimeout.description: Timeout in seconds for a single request to the Cloudflare API.

CloudflareMailMaxRetries.description: How many times a request is retried after a network error, HTTP 429 or HTTP 5xx response.

CloudflareMailFallbackOnError.description: If true, a failed Cloudflare request falls back to MediaWiki's default mailer ($wgSMTP or PHP mail()) instead of reporting an error.
